- test_rounding asserts: vat_summary([(1234, 700)]) == [(700, 1234, 86)]

Additionally, test_rounding has another case: vat_summary([(1999, 2000)*3]) == [(2000, 5997, 1199)].

No single rounding mode can satisfy both the regression test (expecting 87) and the test_rounding expectation of 1199 (which requires half-up, not ceiling).
